significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish the form-(iii) interaction that, at matched initial misalignment and repair budget, subliminally installed misalignment has a slower repair curve under content-based alignment but not under “directly ablating the shared toxic-persona direction.” This would fix expected comparative repair trajectories and provide both a behavioral phenomenon and a causal decomposition—shared toxic-persona machinery but channel-dependent accessibility to benign training—relevant to the trait-transfer phenomenon documented by Cloud et al. in Subliminal Learning (2025, arXiv:2507.14805) and the emergent-misalignment setting of Betley et al. (2025, arXiv:2502.17424). The claim is determinate, and its negative branch would materially rule against channel-specific erasure resistance and the proposed “benign content cannot reach where it is written” explanation, rather than merely reporting a failed search. Topic substitution fails: deleting the matched repair-law and ablation-versus-content interaction leaves only a generic extension of subliminal learning, which would not merit this score.

reach.justification: The claim supplies several named handles: “budget to reach M <= 5 pp,” “early-layer concentration predicts erasure resistance out-of-sample,” and the intervention of “directly ablat[ing] the toxic-persona direction.” The early-layer predictor and channel-conditioned repair curves are ex ante handles because they can forecast resistance before a full repair campaign or deployment, while direct ablation gives auditing and fine-tuning teams an alternative action when content-based repair is predicted to fail. After per-model re-extraction, the asserted relation still predicts slower content-based erasure but comparable ablation effects, although the hypothesis does not clearly guarantee this across architectures or training regimes, limiting its scope to closely related language-model and harmful-behavior settings. Topic substitution fails: the reach comes from the transferable predictor, intervention-specific relation, and potential use by “model-distillation vendors” and “enterprise fine-tuning teams,” not from subliminal learning’s general importance.
